chunks: Of that, a group informed us from Abu Muhammad al-Talakbari from Ahmad ibn Ali al-Razi from Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi from Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Musa ibn Umar ibn Yazid from Ali ibn Asbat from Ali ibn Abi Hamza from Abu Basir from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
regarding the saying of Allah, the Exalted: 'Say: Have you considered if your water should go down, who is it then that will bring you flowing water?'

He said: It was revealed concerning the Imam. He said: If your Imam becomes hidden from you, who will bring you an apparent Imam who will bring you the news of the heavens and the earth and the halal and haram of Allah, the Exalted?
Then he said: By Allah, the interpretation of this verse has not yet come, and it is necessary that its interpretation will come.

key_terms.غَائِبًا: Hidden/Occulted (referring to the state of ghaybah)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic verse about water becoming sunk refer to in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In this tradition from Imam al-Sadiq, the verse is interpreted as a direct reference to the Imamate, specifically addressing the crisis of the Hidden Imam (Ghaybah) where the source of divine knowledge becomes inaccessible. The Imam emphasizes that the 'clear water' symbolizes the Imam who conveys the truths of the heavens and the rulings of God, asserting that the full esoteric realization (ta'wil) of this verse is yet to be fully manifested. This highlights the Shia belief in the Imam as the indispensable conduit of divine guidance during periods of absence.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 115 - Of the reports is one narrated by a group of scholars from Abu Muhammad Talakbari from Ahmad bin Ali Raazi from Muhammad bin Ja’far Asadi from Saad bin Abdullah from Musa bin Umar bin Yazid from Ali bin Asbat from Ali bin Abi Hamza from Abu Basir from Abu Ja’far Muhammad Ibn Ali (a.s)
with regard the following statement of Almighty Allah: “Say: Have you considered if your water should go down, who is it then that will bring you flowing water?” [67:30]

This verse is revealed about Imamate. It implies that if your Imam goes into hiding from you, while you don’t know where he is, who will bring you an apparent Imam, who can bring you the news of the heavens and the earth and the orders and prohibitions of Allah, the Exalted?
Then the Imam said: Know that by Allah, this verse has not been actualized as yet and it will be actualized in the future.
